skill.name: video-inpainting
skill.description: Use the RunComfy CLI to plan and run prompt-driven video region edits, with guidance for model choice and mask-precise alternatives.
skill.summary: Route video inpainting requests to RunComfy models and explain when a ComfyUI workflow is needed.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md. The static external command hits are Markdown backticks and bounded RunComfy CLI documentation, while the network hits are visible links or placeholder URLs. The main remaining issue is semantic misuse risk from explicit watermark and logo removal guidance.

remediation.issue: Watermark and logo removal can be used to bypass ownership or licensing marks.
remediation.suggestion: Add an authorized-use warning and refuse requests that remove attribution, broadcaster, or licensing marks without permission.

remediation.issue: The skill sends user-provided video URLs and prompts to RunComfy for cloud processing.
remediation.suggestion: Keep a clear disclosure before invocation and require users to provide or approve the media URL used for processing.

semantic_findings.title: Watermark Removal Misuse Risk
semantic_findings.description: The skill explicitly supports watermark and logo removal workflows. This can enable unauthorized removal of ownership, licensing, or attribution marks from third-party media.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill directly lists watermark removal triggers and a common watermark/logo removal pattern. Legitimate cleanup is possible, so this is a misuse risk rather than clear malicious intent.

content.value_statement: Video region edits can be hard to route across models and frame methods. This skill selects a RunComfy path and gives clear prompts for object removal, cleanup, and replacement.
actual_capabilities: Routes prompt-driven video inpainting to Wan 2-7 Edit-Video.
Suggests Lucy Edit Restyle for identity-stable region edits.
Suggests Seedream 4-0 Edit-Sequential for short frame-stack edits.
Explains when ComfyUI workflows are needed for pixel-precise masks.
Provides RunComfy CLI examples for video URL and prompt inputs.
Lists exit codes and troubleshooting references for failed runs.
limitations: It does not provide pixel-precise masks through the CLI.
Long frame-stack edits can lose temporal consistency.
It depends on RunComfy account access and CLI setup.
It cannot guarantee perfect preservation outside the requested region.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Owned Footage
use_cases.description: Remove a distracting object, cable, or blemish from video that the user owns or has permission to edit.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Clips
use_cases.description: Replace or refine a visible region while keeping the rest of a product clip stable across frames.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visual Effects
use_cases.description: Compare prompt-driven edits with frame-stack or ComfyUI routes before committing to a final workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Remove One Object
prompt_templates.prompt: Use video-inpainting to remove the small object in my clip. Keep all other content unchanged and recommend the simplest RunComfy route.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Model Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my edit goal and choose between Wan 2-7, Lucy Edit Restyle, and Seedream Edit-Sequential. Explain the tradeoffs briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Preservation Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a RunComfy video inpainting prompt for this region edit. Lead with preservation, name the target region, and keep it to one change.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Mask-Precise Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the safest workflow for a clip that needs exact mask propagation. Include when to leave the CLI and use a RunComfy ComfyUI workflow.

output_examples.input: Remove a small logo from the bottom-right corner of an owned clip.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Wan 2-7 Edit-Video. The prompt targets the bottom-right logo, preserves all other content, and saves results to the output folder.

output_examples.input: Change a jacket color while keeping the person recognizable.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Lucy Edit Restyle. The guidance focuses on identity stability, one region change, and checking frames for drift.

output_examples.input: Edit a short low-frame-rate sequence frame by frame.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Seedream 4-0 Edit-Sequential. The plan treats frames as still images, then advises re-encoding only after review.

best_practices: Use media you own or have permission to edit.
Describe one region and one change per run.
Use ComfyUI workflows when masks or temporal consistency must be precise.
anti_patterns: Do not remove ownership marks from third-party media without permission.
Do not combine many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Do not use frame-stack editing for long clips that need motion coherence.

faq.question: Does this skill perform the video edit itself?
faq.answer: It guides and invokes RunComfy CLI routes when the CLI is available. RunComfy performs the cloud processing.

faq.question: Which model is the default?
faq.answer: Wan 2-7 Edit-Video is the default for prompt-driven region edits across video frames.

faq.question: Can it use exact masks?
faq.answer: The CLI routes are prompt-driven. Exact mask propagation requires a RunComfy ComfyUI workflow.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads completed outputs to the output directory chosen for the run.

faq.question: Does it send videos to RunComfy?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow sends the user-approved video URL and prompt to RunComfy for processing.

faq.question: Can it remove watermarks?
faq.answer: Only use that workflow for media you own or have clear permission to edit.
